name: Rovin Capital

people.name: Markell Anthony Staffieri
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of SNOW RIVER CORP)
people.bio_note: CEO and President of Rovin Capital (indirect owner via Snow River/Snowy River Corp). Joined the financial industry in 2008; holds Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC) and Certified Wealth Strategist (CWS) designations. Notable pre-finance career: competitive football player who signed as a free agent with the Philadelphia Eagles. Grew up in Solana Beach, CA; served a two-year church mission in South Carolina; is an Eagle Scout; married with five children. Publicly quoted on the CW Advisors acquisition: 'Joining CWA allows us to elevate the service we provide to our clients with enhanced client solutions and access to expanded resources.'
people.bio_source: Pulse2 acquisition coverage (pulse2.com/cw-advisors-acquisition-of-849-million-firm-rovin-capital) quoting Staffieri directly, corroborated by Rovin's own team bio page

people.name: Kimball Eric Pierce
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of BLUE KING MOMENTUM INC)
people.bio_note: COO, Partner & Wealth Advisor at Rovin Capital (indirect owner via Blue King Momentum Inc), 18+ years in finance. Career path: started as a broker with Edward Jones (2005), moved to Morgan Stanley (2006), took a two-year religious mission in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala, then rejoined Morgan Stanley (2009) before being recruited to Goldman Sachs (2010), where he managed hedge fund client relationships and supported prime brokerage trading. Holds a B.S. in Business Management from Brigham Young University and the ChFC designation.
people.bio_source: LinkedIn profile, K. Eric Pierce, ChFC, corroborating Rovin's team bio page

people.name: Matthew Ds Staffieri
people.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer at Rovin Capital as of 2026; has also been an Investment Advisor at the firm since 2013 (12+ years), holds a Series 66. Separately Founder, CEO, and CIO of Artegius Capital, Inc., a fund-management investment firm (corrected from an earlier 'president' title per his own LinkedIn). Shared surname with Markell Staffieri suggests a possible family tie, but no independent source confirms a relationship between them.
people.bio_source: Wealthminder and Indyfin profiles, independent of the firm website. Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): neither Wealthminder nor Indyfin mentions Artegius Capital at all; his own LinkedIn lists him as 'Founder and CEO and Chief Investment Officer' at Artegius, not 'president' -- corrected the title.

data_quality_flags: Website returned HTTP 502 on every attempt (site down or blocking automated fetches) — no website-based partner check was possible for this firm.

firm_note.text: Rovin Capital, LLC is a Mesa, AZ (with Lehi, UT office) RIA with $849M-$917M AUM, founded 2010. IMPORTANT: in February 2026, Boston-based CW Advisors (a subsidiary of Osaic Holdings) announced its acquisition of Rovin Capital to expand its western U.S. footprint — this firm is likely no longer operating independently and may not be a viable acquisition target.
